description: This file defines the DVar class, which implements the DVAR function for database variance estimation in spreadsheet calculations. It provides functionality to compute the variance of filtered database data based on specified criteria.

classes.name: DVar
classes.description: Class implementing the DVAR database function to estimate the variance of a population based on sampled data, filtered by criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the variance of a filtered database column based on criteria, or returns an error if the field is invalid.
